nom: Oak Essentials Restorative Face Mask with Organic Honey

avis.texte: My fave mask! Skin is sooo soft and definitely healthier. Happy ritual each Sunday morning: a cup of fancy tea and this mask. Doesn't get any better than this!

I just this last week for the first time and all I can say is more please. I've tried many masks over the years and by far this is my favorite. I can actually say that so far I love all your products and am so happy I have switched.
I'm using this twice weekly and really seeing the results. I seldom find products that I truly see a difference but I do with Oak Essentials
I'm not a big mask gal, but this one is lovely. It is a bit sticky which is different than I was used to. But overall nice to apply and take off. Leaves skin feeling soft and rejuvenated
Smooth applying on. Mask smells fresh and honey-like. Very hydrating for my skin.
Great mask- cleans without drying out skin. Will definitely reorder!

This is like a little bit of luxury on your face at home. Every bit of a spa experience at a fraction of the price. I've been to spas all over the world and this is up there with the best. I will absolutely buy this again and again. I am obsessed with these products.

Fair warning - it's a little messy, but you won't regret it! I like to use it before the shower, which makes cleanup a breeze. It goes on smooth, feels incredible, and it leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and brighter. The warm, honey scent is also a bonus.
Love the smell, organic properties , and the way my skin feels after I use it
Great mask that is super spa like and makes your skin very glowy
I've only used this once so far but I love the natural honey smell to it and how hydrated my skin feels after using it.

avis.titre: This mask is my weekly reset
avis.texte: Iit calms redness, evens tone, and gives me that healthy, rested-skin look. Feels like a professional facial in a jar!"

avis.titre: I see why people love it, just not for me
avis.texte: I got a free sample of this mask when i bought their exfoliator. I was hesitant to use it at first because of the dofferent oil ingredients. My skin is very sensitive, dry, and acne prone. I figured id try it out once and my face is breaking out so bad sonce using it, mostly around my mouth, chin, upper lip area. I used it I think 3 days ago now and they started popping up yesterday. Today its white head galore 🙃 Its a super hydrating mask, the consistency is almost waxy which was also a nightmare to get off. The exfoliator however im loving so far! If you dont break out easily and need some hydration I can see whh youd love this but i sadly just had to throw it away.

I am 77 years old…. I have always taken very good care of my skin and am very fortunate! I really liked a sample I received and bought a jar! It is wonderful…gentle and I saw a difference…my skin glowed! Thank you!
This product is amazing, moisturizing, calming and it leaves your face with a glow. Love it, highly recommend.

I received this as part of a free gift with an unrelated Ulta purchase - not in exchange for a review. A few days later I heard this brand recommended on a pod cast by someone who had no brand affiliation and actually paid for the product. I decided to give it a shot and applied a thin layer after my lactic acid. The consistency is thick/salve-like so I wasn't optimistic. I figured it would worsen the already visible pores or my cheeks. Nope! Not only do my pores look the same, if not better, but my skin feel insanely aoft, and smooth, and firm. I don't think I've ever tried a skincare product that gave me such dramatic results in one use. I used it again today - approximately 2 weeks later - and I'm just as impressed. Enough so that I'm writing this review instead of binging my favorite TV show. I'm buying a full size version tomorrow. I'm eyeing the firming serum too. It's pricey, but based on the reviews (100+ almost all 5 star and nothing lower than a 4) and the great experience I've had with the brand this far, I think I'll take the risk. Highly recommend!
Love the way my skin looks and feels after using this mask. Also appreciate that a little bit goes a long way.

I like this mask. I can't give it 5 stars because it is very thick and sticky and stains every cloth that I use to remove it. That being said it is very moisturizing and does leave the skin feeling very soft.

avis.titre: Restorative Mask - My Favorite Oak Essentials Product
avis.texte: The OA Restorative Mask helps calm my sensitive, dry skin. It soothes my skin. I even use it as a spot treatment for breakouts and bug bites (mosquitoes love me). It is an essential part of my skin care routine.

After going into menopause my face began getting acne. Something I have never had not even as a teenager. In three days as part of my daily routine my acne spots were not visible. However, I did change to the 3 times a week recommendation. Amazing!!!!
Just the right amount of honey and sweetness, this mask is awesome!
This is my favorite face mask ever. My skin glows afterwards.

avis.titre: A mask to end face masks
avis.texte: This mask made my skin silky smooth. The glow up I didn't know I needed!
Smells like honey! So natural. I just love smearing this beautiful, restorative mask all over my face! And when it comes off (so easily for such a thick one) my skin glows!
Saved me on a hot and sunny vacation- I used it every day to keep my skin hydrated!

I absolutely love this mask, im not usually a mask girly but I got this as a sample and tried it and I was hooked, my skin felt so soft and moisturized it was amazing so I had to buy it. I use it once a week and my skin thanks me. Hope you give it a try!
One of my favorite Oak Essentials products. After, my skin looks brighter and healthier. Feels moisturized. I follow with the peptide firming cream and moisture rich balm and I'm good to go-

I really wanted to love this but I had a horrible reaction to this mask. My whole face turned red and extremely itchy! Would not recommend it at all if you have sensetive skin. Could've also been due to the strong perfume smell of the mask. Didnt even have it on for 3 minutes and had to immediately rinse it off ASAP

avis.titre: Gorgeous warm glow, delicious honey scent
avis.texte: The formulation smells heavenly, and makes my skin look healthier and brighter every time I use it. I often leave it on for more like 20-30 minutes, and use it 1-2x per week.
The smell and feeling is sweet and soft- but not cloyingly so. My weary skin felt so lovely after the application of the mask which was gentle but worked its magic.

I was sent this as an Ulta GWP, and while it smelled lovely - it was absolutely not a face product.. I used it on my feet, since it was so incredibly rich and perfumed. It did not wash off with soap and water. I had to micellar water to remove it.
So moisturizing, soothing, and nourishing for my skin. Even calms down irritated skin. The honey does wonders!
this was nice and soothing to apply. Especially with the mask brush.
My skin always feels so moisturized after using this product.
My skin has never felt so soft. I am so impressed with this mask and will definitely be using it regularly!

This mask is so amazing! It leaves my skin glowing, soft, and feeling auper yummy the moment I wash it off. I'll never NOT buy this again! I also love that it is safe to use on the under eye and the lip area, because it does boost moisture in those spots. I can just swipe it on my lips and it's an amazing lip mask/balm and I can dot it under my eyes and it's an awesome eye balm for the day or night. Im a forever fan!!!

This mask is so amazing! It leaves my skin glowing, soft, and feeling super yummy the moment I wash it off. I'll never NOT buy this again! I also love that it is safe to use on the under eye and the lip area, because it does boost moisture in those spots. I can just swipe it on my lips and it's an amazing lip mask/balm, or I can dot it under my eyes and it's an awesome eye balm for the day or night. Im a forever fan!!!
I love this mask. Makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated after.
Wow!!! So impressed by this mask. Leaves your skin feeling super smooth and supple! Smells good too
This mask is amazing! It's intensely hydrating and evens out skin tone. I can't live without it!

avis.titre: Absolutely Incredible! Beauty In A Jar!
avis.texte: I have NEVER wrote a review for anything before here on Ulta but I had to write about this mask. This mask was gifted to me and Oh My Gosh… this is the BEST mask I have ever used! It is so nourishing and hydrating and it left my skin truly glowing! So hydrated and glowy! My skin has NEVER looked so good! This mask is a big time game changer! I have used 2354 different face masks, and this is my #1 by far! Try it yourself! Promise you will have zero regrets!

A lovely luscious emollient mask that leaves your face fresh and dewy. I only wish that I could have a big tub of it!! Definitely recommend for a nice little pick me up. I've just purchased it, and have used it twice already.

This mask is excellent! I only bought this and another product because there was a free gift that I wanted. I had a mask I really liked from a different brand so wasn't looking to switch, but wow! This makes my skin glow. I'm obsessed with this mask.
I love this mask , it smells amazing and I get so many compliments on my skin.

I absolutely love the Restorative Mask! After using it, my face feels incredibly smooth and soft. The texture is amazing, and I can feel the nourishing benefits right away. The addition of honey is a fantastic touch—it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and glowing. It's the perfect treat for my skin, and I can't wait to make it a regular part of my skincare routine!
My favorite mask - so nourishing. I love using it every week.
This mask leaves my skin super hydrated and glowy! It's very thick and sticky while it is on, but definitely worth it. Highly recommend!
The restorative mask is so necessary to your routine. It adds so much to my face and keeps it looking fresh and polished.
I absolutely love this mask! My skin always looks radiant and feels great after my weekly use.
I absolutely love this mask, it smells incredible and leaves my skin looking great. I just ordered a second one!
The Restorative Mask is pure indulgence! It deeply hydrates and nourishes my skin, leaving it soft and supple. The honey and avocado oil combo gives me the perfect glowing complexion every time!
This mask smells great and feels good going on but does not come off easily with warm water or washcloth. Feels like it just smears around leaving a waxy coating that is not for me.

Love everything I had ordered. I'm not sure if the eye cream was supposed to be kind of hard on top but once mixed up it is very hydrating and soothing. I have not used the mask yet but so excited to try it! Very happy with the products.
This is the best mask if your skin needs moisture! I've never had a mask that makes my skin so soft and smooth. I can use less face lotion after doing one of these masks.
Love this mask and the smell of the honey. Leaves my skin so so soft and silky.

avis.titre: Luxe but hard to wash off
avis.texte: Like the face balm, this is very difficult to wash off once it's on. I wash it off with a face towel but once it is off my skin looks glowy.
I love the smell of this product and my skin absolutely loves this mask. I've tried many masks and this is my favorite one. My dry skin is in heaven when I use this!

This is a really nice way to pamper yourself at home. It is comparable to some of the mask products offered by Fresh, which I also enjoy using at home. Although I think it makes my skin feel really nice after, I think the money is better put towards a professional facial.
Restorative Mask is incredible! It leaves my skin feeling rejuvenated and super soft. Easy to use and so effective. Love it!
Like this mask alot. So different than most other masks. Leaves my skin feeling great and clean
This mask is heaven. My skin looks and feels soft, plump, and glowing. So far all the products I've tried have been stellar.
Still coming around to the texture/scent of this one, but gives my skin a nice boost
This stuff is so amazing, I leave it on all night! It does stain so I put a white towel on my pillow.

avis.titre: Not another product out there that can comparable to this pr
avis.texte: When you feel tired , blah , or sunburned , or healing blemishes , this product covers it all !!! I love doing this once ot twice a week , the next morning my skin feels so plump, smooth, and glowy, that it makes going make-up free sooo easy and if you do apply make up , your makeup will look so airbrushed and perfect !

I bought travel size and didn't even finish the product, I bought full size right away! I'm saving my travel size and happen to be using it end of this month! These products are all natural and really do work! I have moisture all day, I've never experienced that in a product before. That's why it's the bomb!! Also, I'm actually getting compliments about my skin! It's crazy how much my skin has transformed since using all the products! It's having the spa everyday at your home!! I'm hooked!! I love it!!
Great mask--I try to use at least 1-2 times per week. It really helps give my skin a great glow!

I've been using this mask for a couple of years now and it remains my favorite. It's gentle and effective and my skins feels softer and more balanced after using. My only complaint is that it stains my white washcloths - so I've started to use darker wash cloths to take it off.
My skin looks so hydrated and happy when I use this and the canister has lasted forever, it feels like. A little goes a long way!

I'm on my third or fourth jar of the Restorative Mask, which is aptly named. No miracles, just a luxuriously rich texture that leaves my skin feeling and looking a bit fresher. One jar lasts for months, too, so it's worth the price.
I love this mask! My skin is very dry and sensitive but this has added so much moisture and instantly calms my redness. Plus is smells so good!
This mask is gentle on the skin and gives a boost of moisture and radiance. I love how soft and glowing my face feels afterwards.
Such a great mask for sensitive skin and it smells like a spa, lightweight, not overpowering and feels luxurious
Super sensitive skin and this mask smells good and makes my skin glow
odd smell, not totally like honey. Best as a thin layer or it's too hard to remove
Such a great mask for sensitive skin. It smells like a spa and makes my skin really beautiful and glowy.
I ordered during a promotion to get this free and was blown away. It's my Saturday morning "me time" treat. I love that it smells like honey!

This mask is hands-down one of the most nourishing and moisturizing masks I have ever used. Putting it on feels like cozying up with your favorite blanket, the results leave a spa-worthy Sunday morning glow.
I love the mask. It really moisturizes my skin. I'm in perimenopause and it's caused my skin to be dry. I've never had dry skin before and this product helps.

avis.titre: Perfect glowy mask with great smell!
avis.texte: I love face masks and this is truly the BEST I have ever used. It feels and smells incredible. It is part of my Sunday self care routine. I actually look more tan after using it! Not sure if that is just my perception or if it's actually real but I LOVE how this makes me feel!

avis.titre: Part of my Sunday night ritual
avis.texte: I recently added the Oak Essentials Restorative Mask to my skincare regimen and couldn't be happier. The mask leaves my skin hydrated and glowing.
This mask leaves your skin so hydrated and softens fine lines and wrinkles. A little goes a long way.
The smell and feel of this mask is amazing. My skin feels so much better after using it. Highly recommend!
Love this mask! It's different than anything else I currently have and leaves my skin so hydrated and smooth.
The mask is amazing and hydrating! The smell on the other hand isn't amazing. It's not awful I kept it on my face for 20 minutes. But the other products smell amazing!!
My skin feels so smooth and hydrated after I use this, I love it. And it smells amazing. I have super sensitive skin and I can use this without any issue!

Got this as a gift. My family knows how important organic and nontoxic products are to me. They were duped. This product has Phenoxyethanol which is a known endocrine disrupter and believed carcinogen and why it's banned in the EU. If you don't care about those things, that's fine. But those who do should be informed.
I like the mask! It feels nice! I wish it was one that would absorb in and don't have to rinse off, as in and overnight mask.

Amazing. I love this mask. It moisturizes, soothes, and really plumps up my skin. I had a CO2 laser treatment on my face and neck t two weeks ago, and this mask was gentle enough to use after the first few days. It really eased the burned look and feel of my face and neck. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Does a great job adding m
avis.texte: Does a great job adding moisture and calming my sensitive skin. Love it.
I use this once a week and noticed the difference from the get go. I use the Oak Essential Mask Brush to apply it and love both products.
I was so excited to try this mask. I had a horrible allergic reaction when trying it for the very first time. Had red welts for days after. I would suggest doing a test patch.
You can smell the honey and see the difference it makes. This is such a fun moment of self care.
